title: lobelia polyphylla var. bracteosa
intro: Lobelia polyphylla var. bracteosa, commonly known as dwarf lobelia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Campanulaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its use as an anti-inflammatory agent and a treatment for respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Lobelia polyphylla var. bracteosa are attributed to its ability to stimulate the respiratory system and increase circulation, as well as its potential to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as lobeline and lobelanine, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
